      Questions

      How long does shipping take?

      Each book is printed when you order. Most orders arrive within 5–7 business days in the US.

      How do I track my order?

      After checkout you get an order number that starts with JJB. Tap Track order at the top of the page and enter it with your email to see where your book is.

      How do I pay?

      Checkout is handled securely by Stripe. You can pay with any major card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

      What if my book arrives damaged?

      Email or text a photo using the contact info below and a replacement is sent free.

      Can I order more than one copy?

      Yes. Choose the quantity at checkout. Books make great gifts for church groups and classrooms.
